text:
Taylor Nguyen: starting a config-only rollout for /v1/chat: lowering max_batch and tightening per-request timeout. No model binary changes.
Taylor Nguyen: diffs:
```
max_batch_size: 48 -> 24
request_timeout: 15s -> 10s
routing_policy: weighted -> latency-aware (geo-preference unchanged)
soft_qps_limit: 200 -> 160
batch_window_ms: 40 -> 30
kv_cache_max_items: 10000 -> 14000
```
Taylor Nguyen: plan: 5% canary for 20m inside today’s change window 18:00-20:00 UTC. Rollout runbook: https://runbooks.internal/releases/config-only-chat
deploy-bot: Canary launched at 1739004321 (canary-id: cfg-9921) for /v1/chat. Observability hooks ON.
Jordan Reyes: just confirming - model pinned to v4.1.0, right? No quantization/weights swapped?
Taylor Nguyen: yep pinned v4.1.0. No model swaps.
Priya Nair: watchlist: p50/p95, tail latency (>+150ms), error_rate, batch_fill_rate, node_evictions, gpu_kernel_retries. Break thresholds: p95 +100ms sustained 10m, errors >1% sustained 5m, evictions >=2/node in 10m.
Casey Morgan: I'll tail logs and traces. If p95 crosses +70ms ping me. Oncall ready.
InfraCI: preflight checks OK: config schema validated, lint passed, canary target endpoints healthy.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics @ +10m: p95 delta +28ms, p50 -5ms, error_rate 0.15%, avg_batch_size -18%, queue_length stable. No evictions. Suggest continue.
Taylor Nguyen: thumbs, promote to 25% after 25m if stable. Leave autopromote disabled.
deploy-bot: Promoting canary cfg-9921 to 25% at 1739005800. Monitoring.
deploy-bot: @ +12m after promotion: p95 delta +55ms, error_rate 0.3%, avg_batch_size -22%, one node reported gpu_kernel_retries=2 in last 5m.
Priya Nair: small retries count ok but keep eye on kernel_retries and evictions. If kernel_retries >3 on any node -> rollback.
Taylor Nguyen: note to team: tighter request_timeout expected to trim long tails, may surface more early 504s from downstream. We prefer that trade for overall throughput.
deploy-bot: At 1739007500 alert: node node-gpu-07 eviction_count=3 in 8m; policy threshold reached. Initiating automated rollback for cfg-9921.
Jordan Reyes: acknowledged. Rolling back good. Any impact on tenants?
InfraCI: traffic rebalanced to previous routing weights. No config drift detected.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 1739007890. Canary cfg-9921 marked rolled_back.
Casey Morgan: saw a 30s blip of 502s for two internal QA tenants, lasted ~3-4 minutes during rollback, then recovered. No customer pages.
Taylor Nguyen: will open a short incident note and propose a smaller timeout delta (12s) for next attempt, and increase kv_cache items more conservatively. Also add an earlier eviction signal (>=2) to pause canary.
Priya Nair: agree. Add a staged plan: 5% -> 15% -> 30% with manual checks between stages. Also add a synthetic load test with mixed small+large prompts before next rollout.
Jordan Reyes: thanks team. I'll update release notes: "Config-only: batching and timeout adjustment attempt (rolled back due to node evictions). Next attempt to use smaller timeout change and staged promotion."
deploy-bot: Thread closed at 1739007900.
